messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout for feature_flag new-routing-v2. Plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with soak windows. Canary cohort = users:random(10%). Hold window: 30m for each step. Pin model version v3.2 for canary. /deploy notes attached.
alyssa: ack. i'll pin v3.2 for the cohort and add a rollback monitor. can we make the first step timeboxed to 15m warmup + 15m soak?
kevin: +1 on shortened warmup. add alert: error_rate > 0.4% OR p95 latency + >100ms -> auto rollback. also watch 429 spikes.
sam: i've pushed a cohort pin tag: `pin:new-routing-v2:v3.2:cohort-canary`. command to run if needed: ```/ff set new-routing-v2 --cohort canary --weight 10 --ttl 30m```
tara: product ok with 10% start. if metrics look good after soak, we can move to 50% for a 1h window. please record release notes snippet: "new-routing-v2: staged rollout, v3.2 pinned for canary, metrics gating"
maria: oncall here — i'll be watching infra for any queueing/backpressure. call me if p95 crosses 350ms. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Canary step applied: new-routing-v2 -> 10% (cohort:canary). Pin applied: v3.2. Start time 1778880654. Expected hold until 1778880854.
kevin: seeing a small p95 bump +18ms, error_rate 0.08% — within threshold. continuing. :thumbsup:
alyssa: good. if we stay green at +/−30m, let's prepare gradual weight shift script for 50%. sam can you queue the 50% patch ready?
sam: scheduled: `ff-weight-shift --feature new-routing-v2 --from 10 --to 50 --steps 3 --interval 20m` ready to trigger. will annotate the rollout in the deploy log.
tara: product requests note in release doc: users impacted = 10% initial, canary pinned to v3.2. QA asked to monitor top queries for rerank drift.
maria: quick heads-up — some hosts hit gc pause earlier, but it self-cured. keeping a 15m closer eye.
deploy-bot: Canary telemetry snapshot: traffic stable at 10%, p95 +22ms, error_rate 0.09%, 429=0.01%. No auto-rollback triggered.
kevin: okay to promote to 50% in 10m if no regressions. set auto-rollback thresholds again before shift.
alyssa: set another guard: if rerank-regression metric delta > 1.5% -> rollback immediately. logging test prompts now.
sam: ready to run weight shift in 10m. will tag the change in the console and attach link to the rollout.
tara: sounds good. thanks all. please post final status in #releases once 100% done. :rocket:
maria: oncall will stay on the thread for the duration. shifting my shift note.
deploy-bot: 50% weight shift executed at 1778880760. Monitoring. Expected window until 1778881160.
kevin: after 10m at 50% still stable. small latency delta but within gating. proceed to schedule the final 100% bump for next maintenance window per plan.
alyssa: leaving the pin in place for the rest of the day per compliance. will unpin after full rollout verification.
tara: product approved final roll. will update release_notes.md with canary details and gating thresholds.
deploy-bot: Final summary: canary -> 10% (pinned v3.2) -> 50% (no regressions). No rollback needed. Close this thread after final 100% follow-up.
